targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	timestamp                                   AS time,
	treat_gen_warning_alarm__value              AS treatment_general_warning_alarm,
	sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm__value AS treatment_general_alarm
FROM marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'treat_gen_warning_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)              AS treatment_general_warning_alarm_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS treatment_general_alarm_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage'

SELECT
	timestamp                             AS time,
		pump_fwd_grey_wat_remavail__value   AS fwd_pump_grey_remavail,
		pump_fwd_grey_wat_running__value    AS fwd_pump_grey_running,
		trans_pump_grey_wat_remavail__value AS trans_pump_grey_remavail,
		trans_pump_grey_wat_running__value  AS trans_pump_grey_running,
		trans_pump_blck_wat_remavail__value AS trans_pump_black_remavail,
		trans_pump_blck_wat_running__value  AS trans_pump_black_running,
		sewage_treatment_plant_on__value    AS treatment_on,
		treat_release__value                AS treatment_release,
		treat_dryrunnprot__value            AS treatment_dry_run_protection
FROM marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'pump_fwd_grey_wat_remavail' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)   AS fwd_pump_grey_remavail_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'pump_fwd_grey_wat_running' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)    AS fwd_pump_grey_running_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_grey_wat_remavail' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS trans_pump_grey_remavail_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_grey_wat_running' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)  AS trans_pump_grey_running_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_blck_wat_remavail' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS trans_pump_black_remavail_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_blck_wat_running' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)  AS trans_pump_black_running_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'sewage_treatment_plant_on' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)    AS treatment_on_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'treat_release' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)                AS treatment_release_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'treat_dryrunnprot' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)            AS treatment_dry_run_protection_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage'

SELECT
	timestamp                            AS time,
	pump_fwd_grey_wat_startstop__value   AS grey_wat_fwd_pump_startstop,
	trans_pump_grey_wat_startstop__value AS grey_wat_transfer_pump_startstop,
	trans_pump_blck_wat_startstop__value AS black_wat_transfer_pump_startstop
FROM marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'pump_fwd_grey_wat_startstop' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)   AS grey_wat_fwd_pump_startstop_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_grey_wat_startstop' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS grey_wat_transfer_pump_startstop_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'trans_pump_blck_wat_startstop' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS black_wat_transfer_pump_startstop_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage'

select timestamp as time,
			grey_water_tank_aft_sb_level__value AS grey_wat_aft_tank,
			grey_water_tank_fwd_sb_level__value AS grey_wat_fwd_tank,
			black_grey_water_tank_aft_ps_level__value AS black_wat_aft_tank,
			treat_holding_tank_level__value AS treatment_holding_tank,
			treat_sludge_tank_level__value AS treatment_sludge_tank,
			sludge_tank_ps_level__value AS sludge_tank
from marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'grey_water_tank_aft_sb_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)       AS grey_wat_aft_tank_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'grey_water_tank_fwd_sb_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)       AS grey_wat_fwd_tank_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'black_grey_water_tank_aft_ps_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS black_wat_aft_tank_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'treat_holding_tank_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)           AS treatment_holding_tank_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'treat_sludge_tank_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)            AS treatment_sludge_tank_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'sludge_tank_ps_level' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)               AS sludge_tank_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage'

SELECT
	date_bin('$__interval', timestamp)               AS time,
	MAX(treat_gen_warning_alarm__value)              AS treat_gen_warning_alarm,
	MAX(sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm__value) AS treat_gen_alarm
FROM marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
	date_bin('$__interval', timestamp)       AS time,
	MAX(pump_fwd_grey_wat_remavail__value)   AS fwd_pump_grey_wat_remavail,
	MAX(pump_fwd_grey_wat_running__value)    AS fwd_pump_grey_wat_running,
	MAX(trans_pump_grey_wat_remavail__value) AS trans_pump_grey_wat_remavail,
	MAX(trans_pump_grey_wat_running__value)  AS trans_pump_grey_wat_running,
	MAX(trans_pump_blck_wat_remavail__value) AS trans_pump_black_wat_remavail,
	MAX(trans_pump_blck_wat_running__value)  AS trans_pump_black_wat_running,
	MAX(sewage_treatment_plant_on__value)    AS treatment_on,
	MAX(treat_release__value)                AS treatment_release,
	MAX(treat_dryrunnprot__value)            AS treatment_dry_run_protect
FROM marpower__340000_sewage
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
